newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Cholera, chickenpox kill 30 in Nigeria.
newsitem.headline: Cholera, chickenpox kill 30 in Nigeria.

text.p: Cholera and chickenpox have killed 30 people in southeastern Nigeria, the independent National Concord newspaper reported on Thursday.

It quoted the coordinator of primary health care in Ikom local council area of Cross River state, Dr Gabriel Ada, as saying the cause was "the filthy environment and contamination of the water source".
A spokesman for the state government said doctors had been sent to the area.
